name: core.openwop.workflows.crm-ops
description: Governed CRM write-verb workflows (RFC 0013, ADR 0208 §2, ADR 0252). Where feature.crm.agents.sales-ops is read-mostly (plus two assistive writes), these chains carry the riskier CRM mutations — owner assignment off a new-lead event, stale-deal follow-up, and the scheduler-fired Gmail inbox sync — with a human in the loop where the ADR calls for one. All tenant-specific values are run parameters (replay-deterministic). Resolves on hosts that ship the feature.crm feature + node pack (the OpenWOP reference app).
author: openwop

chains.label: Route New Lead
chains.description: Bind this chain to the host.crm.contact.created event (Access & data → Host events → bindings) to auto-route every new lead: assign it to a configured owner, then drop a follow-up task on the sales team's board. No approval gate — reassigning an unowned new lead's owner is the low-risk end of the CRM write surface (ADR 0208 §2); creating/converting/deal-stage writes are NOT modeled here.

triggerEventName.description: The host event this chain ignites on. The event belongs to the INSTALLING HOST, not the pack (openwop-1, crosstalk 1892) — defaulted so an existing install keeps working.

ownerId.description: The opaque owning-subject id (RFC 0048) every new lead is assigned to.

orgId.description: The org the follow-up task is created in.

taskTitle.description: Title of the follow-up task created for the newly-assigned owner.

task.description: The follow-up task created for the newly-assigned owner.

chains.label: Deal Hygiene Sweep
chains.description: Reads an org's open deals, then pauses at a human review gate — the reviewer is the one who picks/confirms which deals actually need a follow-up (this chain does not attempt to infer staleness itself; `staleDays` is passed through only as review context). On approval, creates one follow-up task. Pair with a weekly scheduled trigger.

orgId.description: The org whose open deals to review.

staleDays.description: Review-context hint shown on the approval card: deals with no activity in roughly this many days are candidates. Not enforced by a filtering node — the human reviewer applies it.

config.title: Review open deals — flag any with no activity in ~{{params.staleDays}} days for follow-up
Follow up on stale open deal(s)

task.description: The follow-up task created after the reviewer's confirmation.

chains.label: Gmail Inbox Sync
chains.description: The workflow a Gmail inbox sync opt-in (ADR 0252) fires on cadence — a single node that pulls the connected user's recent Gmail messages, matches From/To participants to EXISTING CRM contacts only (never creates), and appends metadata-only email activities (no subject/body/snippet/email) to their timelines. `gmailSyncId` identifies which opt-in row to sync; the CRM Gmail-sync opt-in flow supplies it automatically when it registers the per-user scheduler job — do not bind this chain manually to an event.

gmailSyncId.description: The crm:gmailsync opt-in row this run syncs. Supplied by the per-user scheduler job (or "sync now") registered at opt-in — never set this by hand.

scanned.description: Gmail messages scanned in this pass.

matched.description: Contacts matched and appended to in this pass.
